verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Finix onboards sellers through Onboarding Forms, APIs, and onboarding notifications. Nothing documents tunable or tiered onboarding requirements, deferring data collection until a payout threshold, or per-seller requirements-due states. Generic onboarding is an adjacent capability and earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, onboarding friction is tunable — collect the minimum to start selling and gather the rest before payout thresholds, with clear requirements-due states per seller
